notes:
Primary contact: CTO (Elliot Marquez) + Head of Search Eng (Rina Sato). Use-case: enterprise code search + internal engineering KB. They ingest GitHub Enterprise + internal artifacts (repos, CI logs, design docs).

Key constraints / requirements:
- Index scale: initial POC dataset ~10M files (source code + markdown), long-term target ~120M objects across monorepos. Estimated embedding corpus size: ~4-6 TB (dense vectors + metadata).
- Re-index cadence: nightly full snapshot, hourly incremental index for active repos, ad-hoc immediate pushes on deploy. Must support incremental deletes and fast upserts.
- Latency targets: 95th percentile end-to-end < 250ms for retrieval (ANN) and < 500ms including reranker for code search; interactive dev UX target ~150ms typical.
- Throughput / QPS: baseline 10 qps, expected steady-state 40 qps, observed peaks 220 qps during internal release windows.
- Cost sensitivity: goal cost per query (retrieval + rerank) <= $0.005 for average query; procurement will push back if > $0.02 QP.
- Model preferences: open 7B/13B models for rerank (on-prem or dedicated), prefer quantized variants (int8/4) to reduce cost. Want fallback to smaller reranker or lexical boost on capacity limits.
- Security / compliance: SSO/SAML, SCIM, enterprise KMS support (customer-managed keys), audit logs for query and index operations, EU data residency for subset of repos.
